scope: Focused M14 source checks and actual ordinary HOST M15 builds/consumers for the source changes in this batch. No matched native/deployed acceptance.

required_environment.RUSTC: Path to the qualified Rust compiler
required_environment.CMAKE: Path to the qualified CMake executable
required_environment.M15_DIAGNOSTIC_PROFILE: JSON identifying the genuine qualified HOST namespace and BFD/libdwarf/libelf providers

rerun.note: The genuine diagnostic modules require this explicit provider profile; absent-profile skips are not equivalent to the recorded no-skip run.

fixed_defects.change: Snapshot input before copying the previous stack out so identical and overlapping input/output buffers work.
fixed_defects.regression: 19 C plus 19 Rust behavior cases; same-buffer behavior agrees with an ordinary Linux sigaltstack control.

fixed_defects.change: Reject lengths that are not whole register elements before clamping, copying or invoking providers.
fixed_defects.regression: 28 invalid-length cases in each language, plus existing configured-XSAVE extent and copy-error checks. No host ptrace runtime parity claim.

fixed_defects.change: Stop at the first RUNNING, error or other terminal result while retaining existing waits for BOOTING, BOOTED and READY.
fixed_defects.regression: 17 C plus 17 Rust cases covering transitions, timeout, descriptor zero, errno and cleanup.

fixed_defects.change: Finish the current compilation-unit stream after a successful search so a later independent query starts at the first unit.
fixed_defects.regression: Eight queries across two genuine DWARF units in both C and Rust, including missing-type then successful retry.

fixed_defects.change: Read section VMA at byte 48 under the selected BFD layout; bind consumed field offsets, widths, alignments and C types in Rust and the typed witness.
fixed_defects.regression: Actual Rust tool symbol addresses agree with genuine BFD. Eclair reads two BFD-written dump chunks and their boundaries and rejects unmapped addresses. Existing production pins and guards remain enforced.

actual_HOST_builds_and_consumers.IHK_selection: Actual generated recipes select Rust runtime objects; strict whole70 qualification passes with all 70 function and six data roots.
actual_HOST_builds_and_consumers.diagnostic_tools: Complete current Rust eclair and mcinspect objects link with genuine qualified BFD and bundled libdwarf/libelf providers.
actual_HOST_builds_and_consumers.supervisor: Four actual Rust supervisor cases cover idle, waiting kmsg worker, waiting hung-up monitor and both workers. Each returns Ok and restores the observed descriptor count from five to five.
actual_HOST_builds_and_consumers.consumer_limits: Diagnostic consumers wrap tool mains and use ordinary generated ELF/DWARF/dump fixtures. Supervisor consumers bypass daemonization and issue no mcos event or device request.

IHK_source_recovery.result: Fresh three-stage recovery from the committed manifest reproduced the exact gitlink and a clean checkout.
IHK_source_recovery.note: The tracked bundles preserve custom Rust IHK history that ordinary upstream-only submodule initialization cannot fetch.

remaining_requirements: Reconcile the original native owner through the existing reviewed control path.
Qualify the original supported native profile and matched image, modules and installed tools.
Complete ownership/ABI, actual application/device and resource-restoring lifecycle qualification.
evidence_handling: This public record contains source-level results and reproducible test entrypoints. Detailed local machine records were excluded from publication because their environment metadata requires separate approval.
